.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/antigravi.name: Antigravity command checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/antigravi.description: Checks that installed Antigravity hooks run from both supported starting directories.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/gateguard.name: Claude editing advice checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/gateguard.description: Checks that Claude receives the required advice before editing protected project files.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/gateguard.name: Cursor editing advice checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/gateguard.description: Runs Cursor's editing adviser and checks that its shared rules match the other assistants.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/gateguard.name: Repository authoring advice checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/gateguard.description: Checks the editing reminders specific to maintaining bkit's own sources.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/gateguard.name: OpenCode editing advice checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/gateguard.description: Checks that OpenCode receives the required advice before project edits.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/gateguard.name: Cross-assistant editing checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/gateguard.description: Applies the same editing-advice cases to every supported assistant.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/guardrail.name: Antigravity safety checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/guardrail.description: Checks Antigravity's handling of destructive commands and attempts to read secret files.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/guardrail.name: Cursor safety checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/guardrail.description: Checks that Cursor's command and secret protections agree with the other assistants.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/preflight.name: Session-start checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/preflight.description: Runs session-start scripts and checks their handling of project prerequisites.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/readguard.name: Cross-assistant reading checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/readguard.description: Applies the same file-reading advice cases to every supported assistant.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/session-r.name: First-action reminder checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/hooks/session-r.description: Checks that assistants without a session-start event receive one rules reminder on their first action.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/bats-setup.name: Shell test isolation checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/bats-setup.description: Checks that shell tests run away from the repository they must not modify.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/config-key.name: Project settings checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/config-key.description: Checks the bkit settings declared by this repository's package manifest.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/dogfood-no.name: Installed copy equality checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/dogfood-no.description: Checks that this repository's installed copies match the rendered source templates.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/dogfood-te.name: Adopted template checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/dogfood-te.description: Checks that bkit uses its own project templates according to the consumer installation contract.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/json-parse.name: JSON error ownership checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/json-parse.description: Checks that failed JSON parsing is handled in the single shared owner.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/ledger-int.name: Live record integrity checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/ledger-int.description: Checks that the repository's recorded decisions and workflow evidence remain machine-readable.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/ledger-rea.name: Documented record reader checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/ledger-rea.description: Runs the documented record reader and checks that it selects current entries without changing files.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/package-js.name: Package manifest checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/package-js.description: Checks the package's required distribution settings and metadata.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/readme-mod.name: Published model table checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/readme-mod.description: Checks that the product guide's model table agrees with the installed model choices and scores.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/release-wo.name: Release archive checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/release-wo.description: Builds real package archives and checks the files included for distribution.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/release-wo.name: Release workflow structure checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/release-wo.description: Checks the required structure of the package publishing workflow.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/rules-sync.name: Shared rule equality checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/rules-sync.description: Checks that managed rule blocks stay identical to their source.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/shipped-do.name: Public documentation checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/shipped-do.description: Checks that shipped documentation contains no private internal identifiers.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/test-file-.name: Single-file runner checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/test-file-.description: Checks that the repository's test and lint commands accept every supported test file kind.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/version-ha.name: Managed fingerprint checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/version-ha.description: Checks that installation fingerprints record only files owned by bkit.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/vitest-rep.name: Repository protection checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/vitest-rep.description: Checks that tests cannot silently change the repository's Git identity or layout.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/vitest-tes.name: Test lock execution checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/vitest-tes.description: Checks test-run coordination using the real shared machine lock.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/vitest-tes.name: Test lock decision checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/vitest-tes.description: Checks when a test run needs the shared machine lock and how it uses its worker budget.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/vitest-tim.name: Test time allowance checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/repo/vitest-tim.description: Checks that test time limits scale with machine load and remain capped and connected to each runner.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/auto-.name: Automatic routing marker checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/auto-.description: Checks the commit marker that allows eligible post-merge runs through the cloud workflow gate.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/brand.name: Consumer naming checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/brand.description: Checks that commands and files presented to consumer projects carry the required bkit naming.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/ci-sc.name: Automation helper checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/ci-sc.description: Checks the helper scripts shipped for project automation.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/cloud.name: Cloud startup context checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/cloud.description: Checks cloud workflow credential gates and feature context selection.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/conte.name: Context menu equality checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/conte.description: Checks that documented evidence sources match the sources accepted by the runner.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/conte.name: GitHub evidence checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/conte.description: Checks the documented block for collecting GitHub automated-check evidence.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/conte.name: Provider evidence template checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/conte.description: Checks the provider-specific templates used to collect external evidence.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/conte.name: Vercel evidence checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/conte.description: Checks the documented block for collecting Vercel evidence.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/disk-.name: Checkout cleanup execution checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/disk-.description: Runs the example cleanup step against temporary repositories and extra checkouts.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/disk-.name: Disk cleanup template checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/templates/disk-.description: Checks shipped disk-cleanup examples and the commands that start them.
